exports.label: Observations by Vintage Date, All Observations

purpose: Diagnose one already observed VIX chronology conflict by comparing two official exports with identical observation range and selected vintages. Source qualification only.
transport: Normal public ALFRED form in Mac in-app browser; verify exact form state before each download. Hash bytes before parsing. Two submissions; stop on any rate limit, CAPTCHA or failed export.
validation: ZIP CRC, exact member hashes, series/units/vintage metadata, CSV schema and per-vintage equality against realtime interval membership. Report future-observation presence separately in each source format. Do not infer a correction from agreement alone.
